notebook: Solves 47/50 (revert_free). Reality across all 10 families: every column costs $90-170M/yr; shallow cascades (agent-9 R442: 2 cols $698M/yr cost, agent-7 R441: 2 cols $454M/yr) give $0 revenue because no stream reaches 95% purity -> all rewards negative (-1.0 to -1.6). Positive reward requires either (a) a long train to isolate one component at 95-99%, or (b) a single column with a side draw to grab a middle blend cut (C5 mix ~$618M/yr, C4 mix ~$186M/yr) plus pure top/bottom. Both need many columns; with 3 solves left and every column ~$100-170M/yr, any thin cascade yields non-qualifying streams and negative reward. Best valid = empty design at 0.000, which is what counts as my final score. Decision: lock in empty design, finish. Lesson for the team: the economics only close with a deep, well-converged train; probe splits carefully before committing columns.
